CONFIDENTIALITY
All notes, interview transcriptions, and any other identifying subject information will be kept confidential. I understand that I may withdraw from the study at any time without penalty. I understand that I may take part in this study. You will be kept confidential as a consent form. You decide whether or not to give your name. If you give your name, the researcher will skip the consent form and skip the consent form after you decide whether or not to take part in this study. Your participation is voluntary and you may stop at any time. After you decide whether or not to participate, this form is forbidden without the primary technician's permission.

COMPENSATION: none

I have read and understand I have had the opportunity to ask questions. I understand that, if I choose to take part in this study, I understand that I will be given a copy of this consent form by the primary technician.
